For humans — stop writing curl calls against REST docs.
gws gives you --help on every resource, --dry-run to preview requests, and auto‑pagination.
For AI agents — every response is structured JSON.
Pair it with the included agent skills and your LLM can manage Workspace without custom tooling.
The CLI supports multiple auth workflows so it works on your laptop, in CI, and on a server.
